components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Slate action with a muted blue hover.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#243449);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);font-family:var(--sans,"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:none;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;background:var(--ink,#243449);color:var(--surface,#fff)}.ds-primary:hover{border-color:var(--blue,#315d88);background:var(--blue,#315d88)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#315d88);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White supporting action with a pale blue hover.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#243449);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);font-family:var(--sans,"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:none;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;border-color:var(--line-strong,#a7b4c4);background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#243449)}.ds-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--blue,#315d88);background:var(--blue-soft,#eaf1f8);color:var(--blue,#315d88)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#315d88);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Text Button
components.css: .ds-text{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--ink,#243449);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);font-family:var(--sans,"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:none;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;padding-inline:4px;border-color:transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#243449)}.ds-text:hover{color:var(--blue,#315d88)}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#315d88);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-text{transition:none}}

components.name: Technology Tag
components.css: .ds-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:32px;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3eb);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink-soft,#4b5b70);font-family:var(--sans,"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}

components.name: Domain Badge
components.css: .ds-domain{display:inline-flex;padding:3px 7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3eb);border-radius:4px;background:var(--blue-soft,#eaf1f8);color:var(--blue,#315d88);font-family:var(--sans,"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.68}

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Soft slate navigation with a blue current-page indicator.
components.html: 홈경력·이력서개인 프로젝트
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding-bottom:24px;font-family:var(--sans,"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif)} .ds-nav a{position:relative;color:var(--ink-soft,#4b5b70);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--blue,#315d88)}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]::after{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:-23px;left:0;height:2px;background:var(--blue,#315d88);content:""}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#315d88);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Experience Record
components.description: Flat white record boundary, preserving content hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-record{margin-block:16px;padding:22px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3eb);background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#243449);font-family:var(--sans,"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:18px;line-height:1.68}.ds-record h3{margin:0;font-size:23px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-record p{margin:0;color:var(--ink-soft,#4b5b70)}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-record{padding:16px;font-size:17px}.ds-record h3{font-size:22px}}

narrative.overview:
Quiet Slate makes the existing Korean portfolio easier to read through cool paper, slate text, restrained blue, and flat surfaces. It supports recruiters reading career and technical evidence without decorative competition.

This record describes the active B theme in public/themes/b.css and the layout and component rules it inherits. The companion C theme and /resume/print/ document retain their own presentation. The standalone /portfolio/ screen uses the same palette through src/styles/portfolio-screen.css; its composition and print styles remain independent. No PRODUCT.md predated this pass; the companion PRODUCT.md now records existing purpose and user-approved scope. This document records visual evidence without adding product claims.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, thin borders, and restrained state color.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Blue supports navigation and information; green indicates passing or convergent results, amber indicates limits, and red indicates failure.

rules.name: The Korean Reading Rule
rules.body: Use sans for Korean labels and prose; reserve mono for code, paths, test names, and technical notation.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate content through spacing, tonal surfaces, and thin borders rather than shadows or glow.

dos: Do use the active B palette for themed pages.
Do preserve readable Korean body text and visible keyboard focus.
Do use flat records and restrained separators for technical evidence.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients, glow, background grids, or shadows to the B theme.
Don't turn Korean navigation or field labels into monospace text.
Don't treat companion C or standalone document styling as B tokens.
